title: Adding a HogFlow status transition: what changes together
answers: What must change when adding a workflow status?
Where are HogFlow status guardrails in the API?
body:
- Persisted state: `HogFlow.State` (needs Django migration since `status` has choices); display-only state: `BroadcastStatus` + `getBroadcastStatus` only.
- `backend/api/hog_flow.py`: `HogFlowSerializer.status` (ChoiceField), `HogFlowSerializer.validate` (re-validates actions when activating a draft with no actions in payload), `HogFlowViewSet.perform_create` (blocks active create via MCP), `perform_update` (rejects mixed status+field MCP payloads; routes content edits on active flows to draft).
- Side effects: `hog_flow_saved` post_save → `reload_hog_flows_on_workers` (skips draft-only saves); `_pause_schedules_on_audience_change`; batch job dispatch/cancel (`invocations/cancel` action, `hog_flow_batch_job.py`).
- `backend/facade/api.py` enable/disable uses State.ACTIVE/DRAFT, refuses archived.
- Regenerate with `hogli build:openapi` (`frontend/generated/api.schemas.ts`, MCP tools in `mcp/tools.yaml`; docs `skills/building-workflows/references/lifecycle-and-debugging.md`).
- Update frontend status table/test.
applies: Status/lifecycle changes on HogFlow; pure display changes need only frontend edits.
